subject: Problems with Group Comparison and Design Sample Size

messages.author: 709cf6648d44d792
messages.subject: Problems with Group Comparison and Design Sample Size
parts:
Hello. I faced the following problem. When I click Group Comparison to start analysis nothing happens. The window with parameters just doesn't appear and there is no error messages. This happens when dataset from the tutorial is loaded (I haven't tested other datasets yet). When I open empty document and try to run Group Comparison the window with parameters appears, but when I load data it doesn't work again.

What about Quality Control - it works. Design Sample Size works partly. When I click "Design Sample Size" in the menu the window with parameters appears, but when I try to run it the window with error appears (I used this window to report about this error).

Because Quality Control works I decided to change the path for it in Tools/External Tools and to type there the path for Group Comparision script. When I tried to click on QC, standart window with parametrs for QC appeared and when I pressed OK the script for Group Comparision started. And of course as row with parameters was incorect an error appeared in the Immediate Window. So the problem is not in the script but in the Skyline.

I would be grateful if you could help me, because I just don't know what to do.

messages.author: 709cf6648d44d792
messages.subject: Re: Problems with Group Comparison and Design Sample Size
parts: First of all I would like to thank the team of developers for the prompt help. Their advice helped me. To fix this problem one needs to change locale to "English (US)". Alternative solution is to change only two parameters in local settings: decimal separator (should be set to ".") and list separator (should be set to ",").
